changed_assertion_boundaries.case: Merged raw jaw/rest editing, publication retry, RBF editing and export presentation
changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Thirteen editor/export cases repeated the scene merge as preparation for testing an already merged surface.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: The real profile builder constructs that surface once; each case acquires private files and scene state, asserts merged presentation, and retains every original editor, geometry, publication and identity assertion.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Real merge and split were performed to create paired backup records.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Real backup tracking creates paired operation records around small file changes; retention checks pairing and distinct IDs directly.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Every routing combination repeated full geometry export and checked joint count and last joint name.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Real exporter construction and the Blender operator run against an autospecced run boundary; assertions cover exact exporter class, selected component, source path, destination name and texture exclusion.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Full DNA imports provided two paths to the output-folder validator.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Registered minimal RNA and real temporary paths exercise the same validator and exception assertion.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: An exact directory listing rejected unrelated local measurement tools.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Required benchmark files remain required; AST inspection rejects transitive CI dependencies on local probe tools.
retained_integration: Existing CI benchmark invocation and subprocess boundaries

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Each parameter called the merge operator as a setup precondition.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: The profile builder calls and asserts the real merge once; each lease asserts its requested merged state before the unchanged import and native-output checks.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Expected an obsolete confirmation sentence, failing on the original baseline.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Asserts the existing production confirmation sentence with the same exact generated count; read-only file and key checks remain unchanged.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Four 85-frame timing loops verified binding count but never asserted frame outputs or a runtime threshold.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: All 42 original targets, their full geometry and four name-mode transitions remain. Three distinct frame/control samples per mode compare every evaluated channel to the real SDK. Scene bones are limited to native inputs, observed outputs and ancestors because this case asserts shape-channel values, while deformation matrices remain elsewhere. Complete-suite performance is measured separately.

changed_assertion_boundaries.case: Native graph copy and equality helpers
changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Python deepcopy recursively visited every scalar; exact equality recursively revisited large equal scalar arrays.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Trusted in-memory graphs are independently copied with pickle; scalar-list equality short-circuits in C with explicit nested-container and NaN safeguards. Native modules restore private containers from a session archive built through the SDK, then detect reference mutation at teardown. Exact comparisons and mismatch paths are unchanged.
retained_integration: test_graph_fixture.py ownership, independent archive restoration, tiny float differences, metadata and NaN checks
All original native graph, projection and round-trip tests

changed_assertion_boundaries.case: Merged editor rollback and selection fixtures
changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Full geometry and output skeletons were rebuilt for rollback, selected-component publication and list-availability assertions.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Compact native DNA and observed scene bones retain real transactions, UI callbacks, native channel counts, canonical vertex ordering and untouched-component byte comparisons. The failed-bridge test reads the fixture's actual seam map.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Every head runtime case loaded full mesh data and materials.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Full matrix and shape-deformation cases retain every original scene joint. Explicit state-only cases keep observed outputs, native quaternion inputs and ancestors. Meshes are loaded only for native_shape consumers; unused materials are omitted. Native input/output arrays remain complete in every case.
retained_integration: Original full-mesh native_shape matrix and deformation assertions

changed_assertion_boundaries.case: Animation, duplicate ownership, component routing and scoped-key transactions
changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Dense geometry and unobserved output bones were repeatedly restored for action routing, ownership, material-node action creation, coefficient and untouched-key checks.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Animation and body-publication fixtures retain the full native skeleton with compact geometry. Duplicate ownership and UI-only runtime cases keep observed outputs and input ancestors. A two-channel compact asset supports independent-key commits at all eight LODs; complete native arrays are compared with the original SDK at every LOD. Real FBX import, baking, render callbacks, reference modes, commit/split and byte-preservation assertions remain.
retained_integration: Full Maya/Unreal pose and deformation matrices
All original exporter and calibrator geometry assertions

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: The profile importer installed full native output bindings and immediately deleted them while trimming unobserved bones, then installed the smaller plan.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: An autospecced native-install boundary is deferred only during narrow-profile preparation. Real readers, mesh and skeleton import, final native installation, shape preview and ownership validation remain. The canary requires exactly one final installation including keys created during preparation. Full importer profiles keep the original path.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Solver refreshes rebuilt joint/control indices for each pose and calculated every shape coefficient once per affected shape.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Derived read-only indices live only in one ReadBatch; shape coefficients are computed once per pose occurrence. Every resulting native pose is compared with an uncached SDK read, and a later refresh reads the document again.
retained_integration: All native RBF round trips and editor pose matrices

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Every influence searched Blender vertex groups by name and fetched the same native joint name again.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Names and existing groups are indexed only for one synchronous mesh import. Exact full native head/body weight dictionaries, preexisting unrelated groups and a removed/recreated group are checked. No vertex, influence, precision or full-geometry oracle is removed.
retained_integration: All original full geometry importer, exporter, calibration and deformation tests

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: The routing/lock test freshly imported every head and body output bone before two no-op editor commits.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: A private no-mesh lease retains complete native DNA, complete solver lists, input bones, observed output bones and ancestors. The actual editor entry, component lock, commit, untouched-component file hash and native binding checks remain. Full output matrices and per-component native round trips remain separate integration oracles.
retained_integration: Complete Maya/Unreal pose matrices and full reference transport

changed_assertion_boundaries.case: Full reference sources, topology validation and second-character import
changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Preparation repeated complete DNA imports and the second-character fixture retained live RNA at session scope.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Owned leases restore complete head or paired-character profiles with all original geometry, bones and materials. The full reference still authors the same controls and animation before saving; all six reference modes retain every frame and reload assertion. Both original and private source DNA files are protected by byte fingerprints. The second character is still imported fresh into the animated scene, and no live RNA escapes the module lease. Calibration cases restore an independent full head before changing topology.
retained_integration: All original test_reference_blend_file parameters and animation frames
Pristine lease mutation and path-ownership canaries

changed_assertion_boundaries.case: Key identity, legacy migration and rollback
changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Three identity and rollback tests rebuilt dense surfaces while asserting naming, canonical source preservation, transaction rollback and cross-component rejection.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Compact native meshes keep a real long-named head channel, source/merged coordinate comparisons, driver routing, legacy metadata migration and rejection assertions. All native outputs still match the original SDK at every LOD.
retained_integration: Both full-geometry numerical and native compact-asset equivalence matrices

changed_assertion_boundaries.case: Named-bone Swing/Twist transactions and native ownership
changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Transaction, UI, visibility and named-output tests rebuilt full scene output skeletons; a multi-character preview ownership test also imported an unobserved mesh.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Owned compact-geometry leases retain every swing/twist output, all native input bones, observed state bones and all ancestors. The complete DNA, evaluator arrays, individual matrix assertions, file round trips and surface checks stay unchanged. The second character is still imported fresh with its complete skeleton. Invalid native buffer/index contracts use the established state profile.
retained_integration: Every-bone rest/offset restoration and real undo/redo
All native head shape, spatial, matrix and fresh-import oracles

measured_hot_path_contracts.change: Skip ownership inspection only when the curve already has the requested mute value. Every changed write still rechecks current ownership.
Use the existing padded triangle grid to prune candidates, then retain the original overlap, barycentric, distance and sorted-index tie rules. Broad or invalid boxes use the original dense scan.
retained_integration: Independent full-scan oracle over boundary, overlap, tie, empty, extreme and invalid queries
All original head/body all-LOD calibration and geometry checks

measured_hot_path_contracts.change: Update the dependency graph directly when the source rig is already active in Pose Mode. Otherwise use the existing mode-switch helper.
retained_integration: Every original Maya matrix and numerical tolerance

measured_hot_path_contracts.change: Cache only field descriptions within one recursive call, copying all current values and filtering preview-only suffixes during traversal.
retained_integration: Independent original serializer and authored-data filter over real RNA, changed values and removed items
Every original Unreal editor pose and companion-preservation assertion

measured_hot_path_contracts.change: Index Blender groups for one operation and preallocate native calibration rows. Keep original weight queries, order, root index and distinct zero-weight policies.
retained_integration: Exact compact native head/body rows for both writers, including zero/root/unrelated/replaced groups
All original export, calibration, geometry and LOD assertions

measured_hot_path_contracts.change: Use scalar integer clamps with the same truncation and bounds as the original NumPy operation.

Dense fallback oracle and all original full geometry/LOD calibration

Yielded-curve mutations cannot contaminate later copies
